title: PDF SOLUTIONS INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: PDF Solutions, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 23, 2026 disclosing a First Amendment to its Credit Agreement with Wells Fargo Bank. The amendment increases the company's revolving credit facility to $75 million and introduces a leverage-based commitment fee structure ranging from 0.20% to 0.50% per annum depending on the debt-to-EBITDA ratio. This is a routine corporate credit facility amendment with no broader market implications.
key_points: PDF Solutions, Inc. entered into a First Amendment to its Credit Agreement dated April 23, 2026 with Wells Fargo Bank as administrative agent
The revolving credit facility was increased to an aggregate principal amount of $75 million
Commitment fee structure changed from a flat 0.50% per annum to tiered rates: 0.50% (debt/EBITDA ≥2.50x), 0.35% (0.50x ≤ debt/EBITDA <2.50x), 0.20% (debt/EBITDA <0.50x)
The original Credit Agreement was dated March 7, 2025
No changes to other material terms of the Credit Agreement
